title: Atomic install of live periodic-setup scripts
objective: Installing the periodic system scripts never truncates a file a service is running; the target gets a new inode and a bad template leaves the live file untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Target inode changes and the old inode keeps its bytes
A template failing bash -n is not installed and leaves no temp file
hosts-file-monitor.service is restarted only if it was running
out_of_scope: Re-running the installer on the host
